verdict.rationale: Zero is an email client, so assigning conversations and rule-based routing is a fair question for it. The evidence shows only personal label management, bulk actions, and AI auto-categorization. Nothing documents assigning threads to teammates, shared ownership, or user-defined routing rules. Labels and auto-categorization are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a team-lead, I can assign conversations to teammates and route incoming mail with rules so ownership is explicit
